label: Bible Study
prompt: Those things, which ye have both _____, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.
verse: Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.
note: Paul's teaching method — watch me, then do it.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous, and his ears are open unto their _____: but the face of the Lord is against them that do evil.
verse: For the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous, and his ears are open unto their prayers: but the face of the Lord is against them that do evil.
note: God's eyes are on the righteous and His ears are open to their prayers — watching and listening.

label: Sunday School
prompt: I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;) such an one caught up to the _____ heaven.
verse: I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;) such an one caught up to the third heaven.
note: Paul, modestly in the third person, describes a man caught up to the third heaven — and admits he can't say how.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For he knoweth our _____; he remembereth that we are dust.
verse: For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.
note: God remembers we're made of dust, so his compassion is tailored to our real limits.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven _____ violence, and the violent take it by force.
verse: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force.
note: One of Jesus' most debated sayings: the kingdom 'suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force.'
